## Switched from GetCourse mainly because…
Switched from GetCourse mainly because I wanted to stop waiting on a technical specialist every time the funnel needed changing. In AXL I rebuild it myself — new setup live in an evening, run it two weeks, keep it or roll it back. The MCP integration means the AI works with our actual data rather than whatever I paste into a prompt, so segmentation and reporting are just requests now. Email deliverability is the weak spot: sending domains drop out and you don't get warned, so I check it manually. Otherwise it replaced three tools for us and I'd pick it again.

results.content:
Preparing some workshops for the next couple of weeks which require MS Copilot. So of course: - Copilot in Excel can no long find data in a sheet that's right there - Copilot in MS365 has been "working on it" for 14 minutes - Copilot on the web keeps insisting it can do things it can't, like export .xlsx "AI-generated content may be incorrect" No sh\t. Doubly frustrating, because just a week ago I recorded a few demos with exactly the same tasks in exactly the same applications, and they worked fine (with the exception of exporting files of course, which Copilot hasn't been able to do since MS nerfed the ability to bounce from Copilot on the web into a Word doc, so that people have to upgrade to use Copilot in Word...)
